assessments.name: description_rated
assessments.description: the description, as it reads now, has a rating answering its last remark

assessments.name: description_accepted
assessments.description: the description is rated, with a score of 3 or more

decisions.name: open_questions
decisions.description: a question of the change is still open

decisions.name: no_open_questions
decisions.description: every question of the change is answered

decisions.name: decision_ready

decisions.name: decision_pending
decisions.description: a decision point is not decided yet

decisions.name: no_decision_pending
decisions.description: every decision point of the change is decided

decisions.name: ratification_pending
decisions.description: a decision waits for its ratification

decisions.name: options_open
decisions.description: an option is still being explored or evaluated

dependencies.name: dependencies_met

dependencies.name: dependencies_pending

derogations.name: no_expired_derogation

risks.name: open_risks

risks.name: unmitigated_risks

risks.name: risks_under_control

risks.name: open_actions

risks.name: no_open_actions

risks.name: pocs_pending

verification.name: unverified_effects

verification.name: reserves_open
